scope: Evidence classification only; preserve the frozen matcher's every exclusion

interpretation.identity-literal-code: Mandatory exclusion under the existing policy; semantic copying or intent is not inferred
interpretation.lexical-review-required: Unordered word overlap or high Jaccard alone is insufficient proof of copied content; existing exclusion remains
interpretation.no-match: No active matcher signal; this is not source approval or corpus admission

futureChangeGate: Any future matcher requires a new policy, independent precision/recall evidence, protected-evaluation custody review and a new corpus; no old exclusion is automatically reversed.
